body.p: A man named Kutshung lived near Qamaqdjuin. One day he was off caribou-hunting; and while he was looking about for tracks, a bear came up to him from behind. Kutshung discovered the bear while it was still some distance off, and succeeded in reaching shelter. The bear had not seen him, but was on the scent of his track. When it came near enough, Kutshung shot it with his arrows. He hit its back-bone and lamed its hind-legs. Finally he killed it.
